checklist.name: Composes configured target lookup

checklist.name: Preserves missing-target behavior

checklist.name: Adds already-current no-op
checklist.description: Returns Move.none when card.listId() already equals the selected target list id.

checklist.name: Preserves move behavior

checklist.name: Uses collection lookup appropriately
